items.exampleEn: Presumably, the train is late because of the snow.
items.exampleZh: 火車大概是因為下雪才誤點的。

items.exampleEn: The expected number of visitors is about five hundred.
items.exampleZh: 預計的訪客人數大約五百人。

items.exampleEn: She spoke openly about her mistakes at the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 她在會議上坦率地談到自己犯的錯。

items.exampleEn: Climbing that mountain in winter is risky.
The old building was deemed unsafe after the check.
items.exampleZh: 檢查後，那棟舊建築被認定為不安全。

items.exampleEn: He deliberately left the door open for the cat.
items.exampleZh: 他故意把門開著讓貓進出。

items.exampleEn: Her conception of a perfect holiday is a week at the beach.
items.exampleZh: 她心目中完美的假期，就是在海邊待一週。

items.exampleEn: We had a long philosophical talk about the meaning of happiness.
items.exampleZh: 我們針對幸福的意義進行了一場很長的哲學對話。

items.sentenceEn: The meeting is expected to last about two hours.
items.sentenceZh: 會議預計持續大約兩小時。

items.audioEn: The company deliberately kept its prices low to attract young customers.
items.audioZh: 這家公司刻意壓低價格，以吸引年輕顧客。
items.questionZh: 這家公司為什麼刻意壓低價格？

items.sentenceEn: It's risky to leave your bag on the train seat.
items.sentenceZh: 把包包丟在火車座位上不管是很冒險的。

items.sentenceEn: Our new boss encourages everyone to speak openly.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的新老闆鼓勵大家坦率發言。

items.stemEn: She told me later that she had ____ ignored my message because she was angry.
items.stemZh: 她後來告訴我，她是因為生氣才故意不理我的訊息。

items.stemEn: After checking the documents, the bank ____ the loan too risky.
items.stemZh: 檢查文件後，銀行認為這筆貸款風險太高。

items.passageEn: Last year, my friend Nora left a stable job to open a small bakery. Many people deemed the move risky, and some told her so openly. Nora, however, had a clear conception of what she wanted: a place where neighbors could meet. She deliberately chose a quiet street with low rent rather than a busy shopping area. The first months were harder than expected, and sales were lower than she had hoped. Nora stayed philosophical. "Every new shop has a slow start," she said. Now the bakery is practically full every morning. Presumably, her careful planning made the difference.
items.passageZh: 去年，我的朋友 Nora 辭掉穩定的工作，開了一家小麵包店。很多人認為這個決定很冒險，有些人還當面直說。不過，Nora 很清楚自己想要什麼：一個讓鄰居可以聚在一起的地方。她刻意選了一條租金低的安靜街道，而不是熱鬧的商圈。頭幾個月比預期的辛苦，業績也比她希望的低。Nora 依然看得很開。她說：「每家新店剛開始生意都比較慢。」現在麵包店每天早上幾乎都客滿。大概是她仔細的規劃發揮了作用。

questions.questionZh: 很多人怎麼看 Nora 開麵包店這件事？
Nora 為什麼選擇安靜的街道？

items.promptZh: 他大概忘了今天的會議。
referenceEn: Presumably, he forgot about today's meeting.
He has presumably forgotten today's meeting.
rubricZh: presumably 表示「大概、推測起來」，可放句首或動詞前
寫 probably 意思相近也可以；「忘了」用過去式或現在完成式都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 philosophical 造一個句子，說說你遇到不順的事時看得開的態度。
referenceEn: I try to be philosophical when things don't go my way.
When I lost my wallet, I was philosophical about it and just bought a new one.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 philosophical，表示「看得開、豁達」（例如 be philosophical about… 等）
